## About
Prime Time Sports Grill is a family owned and operated sports grill on N Dale Mabry Hwy in Carrollwood, Tampa.
Come watch the game on our giant screens with a speaker right at your table, or come out for NTN trivia, craft beer and a plate from our American pub menu. Bring your crew, or just grab a chair at the bar.
We serve food late, so there is a place to eat after the late game. Guests have given us a 4.4 rating across 1215 Google reviews.

## Services
- American pub menu: Casual bar and grill food for lunch, dinner and late night.
- Craft beer: Craft beer to go with the game.
- NTN trivia: Play NTN trivia while you hang out.

## FAQ
Q: Is Prime Time family friendly?
A: Yes. We are a family friendly sports grill in Carrollwood.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You can find us at 14404 N Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, FL 33618.

## What customers say
- "1st time here; the place was so much bigger than we anticipated. Lots of TVs, games and space to entertain. I’m positive this place is happening during football!

The food was very good! Portions were on point! Wings ordered were medium, a little hotter than expected but so yummy we were told. The burger was cooked perfectly. The salad was a very good size.

Only downside was we weren’t checked on at all until after the meals were half eaten to being completely finished,  we all had to wait on drink refills." (Elle Lee, 5/5)
- "Met my family for dinner, it was exceptional. Angie was our server and her service was amazing, I had the early bird burger and I will definitely be back at least once a week. The food is delicious and the staff is very welcoming and makes you feel special 💖" (MARILYN MENENDEZ ARNETT (MmenenA), 5/5)
- "Good local place, food is fresh & hot . We recommend Prime Time 👍🏼
